coverage.reproduced: The average torque at rated current of the three-barrier rotors of Table 3 (the proposed and three literature methods) and the prototype's simulated torque against current angle at 2/3 of rated current (Fig. 11).
coverage.not_reproduced: Torque ripple (mesh-noise dominated; the findings report the model's), the sensitivity maps (Figs. 4-7), the four- and five-barrier rotors (Tables 4-5, whose barrier widths and positions are not given), the inductances (Fig. 10, which include end-winding inductance), the optimized rotor and the efficiencies.

cases.title: Finite Element Calculation of Double-Cage Skin Factors

coverage.not_reproduced: The skin factors against frequency (Fig. 8, a coarse plot), the current-density profiles (Figs. 3 and 6) and the approximate equivalent circuits.
